A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Taspan system]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] when [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Boro Fareed]], a key military officer of the Republic, intended to defect to the Empire. His betrayal was discovered only minutes before he could meet up with his Imperial contacts. Scrambling their forces, the Republic fleet attempted to intercept Fareed before he could escape with his knowledge of the inner workings of the Republic military. 

==The battle==
Arriving in the Taspan system, the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron escorted Fareed's [[Republic transport shuttle|shuttle]], which was being hunted by the Republic fleet's [[Liberator-class starfighter|starfighters]] and [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], destroying at least fourty of the former and damaging the latter, until it could be picked up by an Imperial [[Terminus-class destroyer|destroyer]] that was hiding among the asteroids, where the Republic capital ships could not reach it.
